_readme: This file is NOT wired into the site yet — index.html currently has all copy hardcoded so the page works today without a build step. It exists as the target content schema for whichever CMS gets connected later. Every field here has a matching `data-cms="..."` attribute on the corresponding element in index.html, so wiring a CMS later is a mechanical find-and-replace: swap each data-cms element's static text/src for a template call reading this same key. See README.md for the recommended next steps.

hero._note: Only Doomsnight and Soul Rise are shown — Insomnia and Sofi Tukker slides were removed by request. Each slide has two images: `image` (16:9 banner, desktop/tablet) and `imageMobile` (portrait poster, used below 720px via a <picture><source media> swap in index.html — see .hero__media there).

intro.heading: We build festivals as engineered environments — chrome, light and low frequency.

venues.name: Harbour Event Centre
description: Our home room on the Vancouver waterfront — a low-ceilinged, high-impact space built for nights that run long. Dark surfaces, a full-range rig and sightlines that keep the floor tight to the booth.

It carries most of the year-round programme: touring headliners, label nights, festival after-parties and the residencies we develop in house. It's also available to book for private and corporate events.

venues.name: Tradex
description: An open-span exhibition hall in Abbotsford — effectively a blank box, which is exactly why we use it. Nothing about the room dictates the show, so the staging, rigging and layout get designed from scratch each time.
It's the room we scale into when a production outgrows Harbour: large-format festivals, expos, trade shows and full-build one-offs.

about.heading: Independent, on the west coast
about.body: OFF2 Entertainment Inc. produces festivals, tours and residencies, and operates the Harbour Event Centre and Tradex. We handle programming, production and ticketing in house — which is why our shows feel built rather than booked.

_careersNote: Backs careers.html. `positions` is intentionally EMPTY — there are no real openings, and inventing listings would send real applicants through a real application flow for jobs that don't exist. While it's empty the page renders the open-application block; add entries (shape shown in `_positionShape`) and swap in the .job-list markup documented in careers.html to switch it to a live roster. `applyEmail` is a placeholder address — replace with the real hiring inbox or an ATS link before launch.

careers.heading: Come build live entertainment on the west coast.
careers.intro: We produce our own festivals, run our own rooms and handle production in house — which means the people here get their hands on the whole thing, not one slice of it.

culture.label: The work
culture.body: A season here runs from a warehouse in January to a valley at sunrise in June. Same crew, wildly different rooms — you learn fast because nothing repeats.

culture.label: The team
culture.body: Small enough that your call is the call. Programming, production and ticketing sit in the same room, so decisions don't disappear into a process.

culture.label: The standard
culture.body: We'd rather build one show properly than book four. If you care about the difference between good enough and actually right, you'll fit.

openApplication.heading: No open roles right now
openApplication.body: We hire in bursts around the season, and we keep good applications on file for when we do. If you work in production, lighting, sound, programming or front of house, introduce yourself — we'd rather know you before we need you.

newsletter.heading: Line-ups and presales before anyone else
newsletter.body: One email a month. Announcements, presale codes, nothing else.

label.heading: We sign records we'd play at our own shows.
label.intro: OFF2 Label is the record arm of OFF2 Entertainment. Same crew, same rooms — demos go to the people who book the floors, not an inbox nobody opens.

pillars.label: The sound
pillars.body: House, techno, melodic and bass. If it works at Harbour at 1am it works here — we care whether a record moves a room, not which subgenre it belongs to.

pillars.label: The standard
pillars.body: Finished or near-finished, mixed, ideally mastered. We can hear past a rough master. We can't hear past a track that isn't built yet.

pillars.label: Before you send
pillars.body: No bootlegs, no uncleared samples, nothing already signed. One track is enough — send your best, not your catalogue.

label.smallprint: We listen to everything. You'll hear back only if it's a fit — allow four weeks. Submissions are treated as non-confidential and create no obligation to sign or release; you keep all rights to your music. We use your name and email only to reply to this submission.
